name: Boiler fittings and mountings
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Safety-valve sizing criterion: total discharge at least equal to boiler 'from and at 100 C' evaporation, full rated flow within 110% of design pressure, minimum 20 mm inlet bore; TDS blowdown connection DN15-20; bottom blowdown DN25-50; pressure gauge dial at least 150 mm; two level indicators at 100 kW and above; gauge glass lowest reading 50 mm above the overheating point. Evidence: https://spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/boiler-fittings-and-mountings?sc_lang=en-GB
